function.name: workspace
function.description: Manage workspace entities: responsibilities (ongoing areas of work) and projects (deadline-bound work). Use the entity and action parameters to perform CRUD operations.

entity.description: The type of workspace entity to operate on.

name.description: Name/identifier of the entity. Required for create, retrieve, update, deactivate.

fields.description: Key-value pairs to set on the entity. Used with create and update. Responsibility fields: description. Project fields: description, deadline (YYYY-MM-DD), status (active/paused/completed).
